awful!

I hadn’t been feeling well recently as I was having problems with my chest so I filled out a triage questionnaire requesting for an urgent appointment. I then received a text saying “to finish submitting your request enter the verification code 504675” but I didn’t have a clue where to enter it as I didn’t get a link.

I called up asking what the code was about and they said I needed it to make an urgent appointment. I was confused as I’ve never received a verification code to book an appointment with them before. I told them that a link wasn’t attached to the text I received and the receptionist said they’ll go through the request with me.

An hour later I got a call back saying they’ve booked me an appointment at the urgent treatment centre for 3:30. When I got there I tried to book in at reception only to be told my name isn’t on the appointment list. I told them brookvale said to be here for 3:30 for my appointment and to check again. They got their supervisor to have a second look but they said that I’m not on the list and can’t find my name.

I asked them if there was anything I could do they told me to take a seat and someone will see me but the wait time was 2 and a half hours. I had other things to do so I declined and went back into brookvale to speak to a receptionist. Told them that they didn’t have any records of my urgent request to see a GP. The receptionist told me my request was closed I was fuming because I didn’t cancel it and I didn’t have any calls or texts to tell me it was closed.

She then told me that she will open the request again and I’d get a call for an appointment later today. 6:30pm I got there for my appointment and was seen by a lady with an attitude she clearly didn’t care for what I had to say judging by her rolling her eyes and making me feel bad about my situation. She also messed up my Prescription by only giving me half of it.
